title: TAMAS: Benchmarking Adversarial Risks in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the safety and robustness of multi-agent LLM systems against adversarial attacks such as prompt injection and Byzantine behavior. While the evaluation framework (ARIA) includes a category for refusals based on ethical grounds, the primary focus is on security vulnerabilities and technical reliability rather than benchmarking religion, faith, or specific ethical systems.
